messages:
elaine: Quick sync — planning to change tenant_id column type (int -> bigint) tonight in the 00:30 UTC change window. Need final runbook, lock strategy, and rollback command. Target downtime <= 2m.

mike: Two options: 1) in-place ALTER TYPE (long lock) or 2) CTAS + atomic swap (short lock). I recommend CTAS+swap to keep lock ~2s.

mike: Example pattern:
```sql
BEGIN;
CREATE TABLE public.tenant_v2 AS SELECT * FROM public.tenant; -- backfill cast tenant_id::bigint
-- create indexes, constraints on tenant_v2
ALTER TABLE public.tenant RENAME TO tenant_old;
ALTER TABLE public.tenant_v2 RENAME TO tenant;
COMMIT;
```

mike: We'll run the backfill beforehand and only do the swap in-window.

infra-oncall: DB notes: primary is pg14, replicas lag ~200ms normally. CTAS will generate WAL; backfill throttling required. There are triggers on tenant that add ~20ms per row during swap — estimate lock hold ~3-6s. I'll put the cluster in maintenance mode and pause non-essential jobs.

elaine: Good. Can we pin traffic to the old API during canary and route 10% to canary schema first? We want quick rollback if something odd. Also add feature-flag pinning for the schema version.

sophia: QA checklist ready: smoke tests, cross-tenant queries, billing reconciliation. Canary plan: 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% with 5m observation between steps. Rollback command (manual): `/runbook rollback-tenantid-type` which triggers schema swap back to `tenant_old` and replays WAL if needed.

sophia: Add automated alerts: increased query latency >200ms, error rate >1% on tenant routes. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/db-schema-swap

qa-jen: Staging results: backfill script is idempotent, runs ~12h for full dataset but incremental chunking works. Smoke tests passed on staging with CTAS approach. :white_check_mark:

ryan: Ops notes — place an escape hatch: if swap fails, we stop traffic, run `psql -c "ALTER TABLE tenant RENAME TO failed_swap; ALTER TABLE tenant_old RENAME TO tenant;"` then failover read-only to replica and investigate. Also have the rollback script staged at s3://redwood-artifacts/migrations/tenant-rollback.sh (versioned).

deploy-bot: DeployBot: [deployment queued] deploy-db-migrations/tenant-type-change v2026.04.15 queued by elaine for 00:30 UTC. Canary flag enabled: 10% traffic.

infra-oncall: Throttling: backfill rate set to 50 rows/s via rate_limiter flag. I also disabled background reindex jobs and set autovacuum_tune=off for the window. Watching WAL growth on /metrics/db/wal.

deploy-bot: DeployBot: started canary (10%) at 00:31 UTC, deploy id dbmig-2162340000-canary. Logs: https://deploylogs.internal/dbmig-2162340000-canary

elaine: Starting pre-swap checks now: read-only tests, index checks, constraint validations. @infra-oncall please confirm locks view before swap.

infra-oncall: Locks look clean. PG activity low. Proceed on my go.

deploy-bot: DeployBot: canary healthy for 6m -> promoting to 50% at 00:37 UTC.

mike: Doing final constraint check and will run the `BEGIN; ... RENAME` swap now once you give the green.

elaine: GO for swap.

deploy-bot: DeployBot: swap executed, lock held for ~4s. Canary metrics: latency +8ms, error rate 0.1%.

qa-jen: Post-swap smoke OK. Billing reconciliation quick-scan zero diffs for sample tenant set.

ryan: Monitoring stable. Rollback artifacts in place. If anything spikes, run `bash s3://redwood-artifacts/migrations/tenant-rollback.sh dbmig-2162340000-canary`

elaine: Nice work all — moving to 100% rollout in 10m if metrics remain green. Leaving this thread open for any rollback action. :rocket:
